# Contract fixtures

These former examples exercise catalog layering, prebuilt acquisition, multi-format outputs, architecture
selection, and cluster realization. They are test data, not maintained worker-build instructions. The NVKE
OS-image build owns the entire worker payload. Use `definitions/nvke-v1/` for maintained
product inputs and `scripts/README.md` for runnable journeys.

Catalog metadata and pins retain their original identity-bearing bytes. Historical paths and descriptions in
those bytes do not establish current support. The Definition catalog paths were updated for this relocation.
